ns2:course.label: Computational Process Modeling
ns2:course.description: Development and application of computer models to solve practical problems involving fluid flow, heat transfer, and deformation phenomena. Students will develop and apply a computational model to simulate a process of their choice and complete a project involving extensive computation. Lecture topics include steps in carrying a modeling project from problem definition to final report, advanced topics in computational methods for materials process modeling, and case studies. Same as CSE 561. Prerequisite: ME 450 or equivalent; either ME 412 or ME 471; or consent of instructor.
